## Issue Type

- [ ] Incorrect IOC extraction
- [ ] Wrong TTP mapping
- [ ] STIX bundle error
- [ ] Documentation issue
- [ ] Other

## Description

A clear description of the issue.

## Report ID (if applicable)

If this relates to a specific report on the platform, provide the report ID or URL:

```
Report ID: 
URL: https://ti-mindmap-hub.com/report/...
```

## Expected Behavior

What did you expect to happen?

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened?

## Evidence

If reporting an extraction error, please provide:
- The original text (snippet)
- What was extracted (incorrect)
- What should have been extracted (correct)

## Additional Context

Any other context about the problem.
